messages:
maria-sales: Quick context — Zenith Health wants a POC next week. Requirements: streaming SDK, function/tool calls that return structured JSON (medical record extraction), SAML SSO, KMS integration, and a pricing comparison (hosted vs dedicated). Any immediate blockers?

aj-eng: looping in infra + ml folks. @devon-ml @sam-security — need a quick feasibility check.

devon-ml: High level: doable. Two notes: 1) use function-calling for structured output + validate schema client-side (we suggest Ajv). 2) streaming: SSE ok for quick web demo; websocket or raw TCP for sustained QPS. Backpressure matters.

devon-ml: Node snippet for streaming + function call (very small):
```
const s = redwood.stream({ model: 'open-med-1', streaming: true })
s.on('data', (chunk) => {
  // chunks include tool-call events + text tokens
})
await s.functionCall('extract_ehr', { patient_id: '1234' })
```

aj-eng: Implementation tips:
- enable prefix caching for repeated patient prompts
- set max_concurrent_requests to 6-8 for the POC to avoid OOM on smaller dedicated pools
- for tool calls, set tool_timeout_ms = 30000 and fail-open to hosted fallback if private capacity constrained

sam-security: Security checklist:
- SAML SSO: supported. We can integrate with their IdP.
- KMS: we support customer KMS for Private and Dedicated; hosted can use customer-managed keys via supported KMS providers (requires enterprise add-on).
- SOC2: we have SOC2 Type II report and encryption whitepaper.
Note: Zenith insists PII cannot leave their network -> this becomes a blocker for hosted. Private (VPC or on-prem) required. Lead time ~6-8 weeks and legal review.

irina-docs: I have a short POC runbook and a sample SDK repo for structured output + Ajv validation. Can share a link and a minimal JSON schema for the extract_ehr function. Also a short checklist for SAML metadata exchange.

maria-sales: Pricing ask from Zenith: expected volume ~10k streaming sessions/day, avg ~350 tokens/session, ~1 function call/session. They want a hosted estimate and a dedicated reserved estimate.

aj-eng: Rough hosted calc (very approximate): token pricing + streaming overhead -> ~ $6k/month for their volume assuming standard hosted rates and no special tooling.

aj-eng: Dedicated: if they need <2ms p99 and sustained throughput, recommended a small reserved pool (equivalent to ~2 x A100-class instances depending on model). Ballpark for reserved capacity + support ~ $20k-$30k/month. Exact quote from sales ops.

sam-security: Another blocker: legal requires data processing addendum + encryption at rest w/ customer keys. That adds contract time.

maria-sales: Ok — action items: schedule kickoff tomorrow 10am PT if possible. Owners: aj-eng = tech lead for POC, irina-docs = runbook + SDK examples, sam-security = security questionnaire & SOC2 docs, maria-sales = coordinate with Zenith and pricing follow-up.

aj-eng: I'll prep an internal POC checklist: network requirements, SAML metadata, KMS key ARN format, estimated infra lead times, and a minimal demo app. Will post repo link here before EOD. :thumbsup:

irina-docs: Posting the sample schema and a short demo in #repos shortly.

sam-security: I'll open the security questionnaire thread and attach SOC2 + encryption notes. If Zenith wants on-prem, need legal + infra heads on the call.

maria-sales: Thanks everyone — Zenith wants to lock calendar today. I'll DM invites.

legal-bot: Notice: please attach the standard DPAs and request CISO contact info before we share production-level artifacts.

maria-sales: noted. assigning invites now.
